A maintenance release: the window no longer freezes when it is out of view on Wayland, the window records every way it can end, and the default temperature limits come from published ratings.

## What changed

- On Wayland (seen on Hyprland with an NVIDIA GPU) the window could freeze and be offered for termination as "not responding" when it was out of view: on a workspace no monitor shows, or under a fullscreen or maximized window. The window now takes its pacing from the compositor's frame callbacks, keeps running its logic while none arrive, draws nothing, and paints again as soon as it is shown. This is [egui pull request 8631](https://github.com/emilk/egui/pull/8631), carried in `vendor/eframe` until egui 0.37 is released. X11 is unchanged.
- The window records every way it can end, so a window that vanishes can be traced. A startup or event-loop error is written to `~/.local/state/hwglance/crash.log` and the journal (`journalctl --user -t hwglance`). SIGTERM, SIGINT, SIGHUP and SIGQUIT are recorded there too, with the sender's pid, uid and process name. A normal exit logs one line saying whether the window's own Close button or a close request from the compositor or window manager closed it, and each start logs one line with the version, pid and parent process.
- New default temperature limits, set from published ratings (CPU, integrated GPU, NVIDIA core, hotspot and memory, DIMMs, listed NVMe drives and the ASUS EC's VRM reading). Limits you set yourself are not changed.

The full list is in the [changelog](https://github.com/Raed-Alghamdi/hwglance/blob/v0.1.2/CHANGELOG.md).

## Install or update

Arch Linux, from the package attached below:

```sh
sudo pacman -U hwglance-0.1.2-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst
systemctl --user restart hwglanced
sudo systemctl restart hwglance-helper   # if you use the optional helper
hwglance-bar-widget update               # Omarchy only, if you installed the widget
```

For a first install, enable the services instead: `systemctl --user enable --now hwglanced` and, optionally, `sudo systemctl enable --now hwglance-helper`, then `hwglance-bar-widget install` on Omarchy.

Other x86_64 Linux distributions, from the tarball (prebuilt, no Rust needed):

```sh
tar -xzf hwglance-0.1.2-x86_64-linux.tar.gz
cd hwglance-0.1.2-x86_64-linux
./install.sh
```

Check downloads against `SHA256SUMS`. Requirements and optional components are in the [README](https://github.com/Raed-Alghamdi/hwglance#what-you-need).
